summary: Penguin Solutions filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of $750M (plus $100M greenshoe) of 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Net proceeds of ~$735.1M are used to repurchase $135.5M of its 2.00% 2029 notes and $160M of its 2.00% 2030 notes, pay $49.1M for capped call transactions, repay $100M of a credit facility, and for general corporate purposes. The notes are zero-coupon, mature August 1, 2031, and convertible into cash and possibly shares. The transaction refinances existing debt and reduces interest expense. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for dilutive conversion overhang and share price action relative to conversion price.
